title: A Market Moves Indoors
transcript: The Glenford farmers' market will move into the old bus station for the winter. The market will continue to open on Saturdays, but the opening time will change from eight to nine in the morning. Organisers say the new building will protect shoppers and sellers from wind and rain. Most of the regular sellers are moving with the market. A free shuttle bus will run between the new site and the library car park every twenty minutes.

questions.prompt: Where will the market operate during the winter?
questions.explanation: 旧汽车站是市场冬季的新址。

questions.prompt: What is the advantage of the new site?
options: It is closer to local farms.
It can hold twice as many sellers.
It has a larger public car park.
It provides shelter in bad weather.
questions.answer: It provides shelter in bad weather.
questions.explanation: 新建筑可使买卖双方免受风雨影响。
